agents.rationale: All three foundation tasks are static reads establishing the frontmatter contract and the P6 four-part template. No file writes; single agent sequentialises T001 → T002/T003 naturally. T002 and T003 are [P]-marked but folded here because they produce no side-effects and their outputs are required by both US1 and US2 chains before any write begins.

batches.label: Phase 2+3 — US1 and US2 chains in parallel (disjoint files)

agents.rationale: US1 sequential chain. All four tasks touch the same file; T005 depends on T004 (P7 bullet must exist before the detail section is added), T006 depends on T005 (Anti-patterns bullet added after detail section), T007 is the read-only verification depending on T006. File is disjoint from agent B2-impl-b.

US2 sequential chain. T008 creates the file; T009–T012 progressively extend it; T013 is the read-only verification. All six tasks touch the same file; chain is strictly sequential within the agent. File is disjoint from agent B2-impl-a.

T014 appends the 7-ui-verification.mdc entry to asset-registry.yml. Depends on T008 (file must exist) which completes in B2. Isolated in its own batch to avoid asset-registry writes racing with the US2 chain and to maintain a clean dependency boundary: registry is updated only after the new rule file is fully authored and verified.

T015 performs a read-only rg/test sweep across all three deliverables. Depends on T007 (US1 complete), T013 (US2 complete), and T014 (registry updated) — all of which have completed by B4. Single agent because the task is a cross-file read and cannot be parallelised internally.
